explication: Gemini CLI is a terminal-based AI coding agent. Its main workflow takes a developer prompt through the interactive or scriptable CLI, uses core model and tool capabilities to produce a response or perform work, and presents the result in the terminal. The repository also includes documented MCP extensibility and checkpointing, plus a separate A2A server. The graph preserves these product branches and selected internal layers; source excerpts are partial, so undocumented runtime links are omitted.
